question: Does the DeepSeek-V4 technical report (arXiv 2606.19348) describe a post-training stage where separately trained domain-expert models (math, code, agents, instruction-following) are merged into a single unified model via on-policy distillation? Quote or paraphrase the exact post-training pipeline description, and state whether 'consolidation via on-policy distillation' appears in the paper.
answer: Yes, the DeepSeek-V4 technical report describes a post-training pipeline where separately trained domain-expert models are unified via on-policy distillation [1][2]. The report states: "The post-training pipeline of DeepSeek-V4 series features a two-stage paradigm: the independent cultivation of domain-specific experts, followed by unified model consolidation via on-policy distillation" [1][3]. In this process, a unified model acts as a student, learning to minimize reverse KL divergence against the specialized teacher models [1][3]. The phrase "unified model consolidation via on-policy distillation" explicitly appears in the paper [1][3].
